cues: Picture the free energy of the mixture as the reaction proceeds.
From either end, G runs downhill, and the reaction moves until G reaches its lowest point.
At that minimum, there is no further tendency to change.
There, delta G is zero, and Q has become K.
text: Picture the free energy of the mixture as the reaction proceeds. From either end, G runs downhill, and the reaction moves until G reaches its lowest point. At that minimum, there is no further tendency to change. That is equilibrium. There, delta G is zero, and Q has become K.
